observations.tap_identity_basis: Inferred from monotonically scanned taps and first32-bit passing bitmap; failure line does not print tap separately.

register_interpretation.SMHC3_IDST_bit5: ERR_FLAG_SUM: card error summary, not a DMA bus fault or generic abnormal interrupt summary.
register_interpretation.SMHC3_IDST_bit4: Descriptor unavailable; continue treating as fatal to tuning.
register_interpretation.SMHC3_IDST_bits3_2: Reserved in SMHC3 manual; generic donor bit2 means fatal bus error. If observed set, reject conservatively without enabling/writing reserved fields.
register_interpretation.RINT_0xac: DCRC bit7 plus receive data request/completion/command completion bits5/3/2; noFIFO/HW-lock bits11/12.
register_interpretation.DMA_completion: Both128-byte counters and OWN0 plus healthy reset support a completed but CRC-invalid tuning transfer. It is still a failed tap, never a successful data transfer.

cause: v22 execute_tuning treats both IDST[4] and[5] as fatal. A valid scan must mark the CRC-invalid tap failed and may continue read-only trials after healthy bounded reset; it must not abort merely because the matching card-error summary is set.
proposed_guarded_fix: Separate tuning-only error classification; normal file/data I/O must continue rejecting all reported card errors.
Allow IDST5 only with matching RINT EBE/RTO/RCRC/SBE/DRTO/DCRC/RE in the same failed transaction; unexplained summary remains fatal.
Keep IDST4, dma_dead, ios_error and FIFO/HW-lock fatal; reject reserved/unknown IDST bits conservatively, including bit2.
Treat RINT10 starvation and18 write-busy timeout as unexpected hardware errors in read-only CMD21 tuning, not as card-error-summary recovery.
Retain short polls, soft global deadline, fresh poisoned patterns, per-tap20 successes, minimum12 contiguous window and final16 validations.
Any candidate must be separate version with final static classification tests and independent review before a new200MHz trial.
correction_to_earlier_review: Earlier HS200 static review accurately described the v22 IDST4/5 fatal code but failed to distinguish SMHC3 card-error-summary semantics. This new hardware-backed review corrects that judgment; earlier frozen evidence is retained.
acceptance_boundary: 100MHz remains passed. This failed200MHz boot is not acceptance, and the first32 passing taps do not certify the untested remainder or200MHz file I/O.
